_doc: The Hedera act's timeline at 60 fps, read by Act.tsx (pictures) and prep/sponsors/hedera.py (sound). Each shot: at, len, and its events as offsets from the shot's start: cards (a card spawning), chirps, hits (stamps), glitch (an inner cut or a screen coming up), typing ([from, to, every]). Lines: the subtitles (at, len, and text variants: todo = before built.hedera, done = after). A line marked slot belongs to the HashScan slot and gives way to the field-report clips.

lines.todo: The seed comes from Hedera's running hash at START.
Nobody, including the console, can know it before START reaches consensus.
Every 2 seconds of play, a checkpoint goes to an HCS topic.
Inputs must be committed within 15 s plus 3% of real time.
On a 90 s run, that caps pauses and slow motion at about 18 s.
PB, your coach agent, buys the ghost of the runner just ahead.
It pays her over x402, in USDC on Hedera, straight to her account.
No human approves the payment: PB stays under the caps you set.
No Solidity: two native services, through the Hedera SDK.
HCS keeps the clock and the receipts. HTS moves the USDC.
The payment shows on HashScan. We film this slot at the event.
lines.done: The payment shows on HashScan, from PB straight to the runner.
